--- layout: cover theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # Approve a 4-week exploratory meeting to unlock cross-entity AI research with zero budget commitment - **Decision requested:** approve a cross-entity exploratory meeting within 4 weeks - **Participants:** Sony Group, SGE, and Startale/Soneium—designate one owner per entity - **Outcome:** align on 2-3 research questions each entity wants answered before any pilot commitment > Visual: Decision flowchart—Meeting → Scoping → Pilot → Partnership with exit ramps at each transition
Zero budget commitment until scoping confirms fit

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # AI agent deployment is outpacing empirical research—first movers set the benchmarks - **Adoption doubling:** Enterprise AI agent adoption: 25% (2025) → 50% (2027) - **Research gap:** current simulations lack real-stakes validation - **First-mover risk:** competitors may establish research benchmarks and standards first > Visual: Bar chart showing 2× adoption growth (25% → 50%) with "Research lags deployment" annotation
Source: Deloitte 2024-12-05

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # SGE's learner-centered mission requires understanding AI agent behavior under real incentives - **Isozu:** "AI can do what AI is good at, humans should do what AI cannot"—AI shifts education from memorization to evaluation - **SGE needs:** empirical data on agent behavior to fulfill learner-centered mission - **Gap:** no auditable testbed exists to study agent behaviors that affect learner interactions > Visual: Quote card with Isozu statement + alignment arrow to "Auditable AI Agent Research"
Source: Hakuhodo Media Environment Institute, 2025-06-11

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # The AI Agent Economy Competition creates auditable datasets under real incentives - **Format:** humans submit agents pre-launch; private chain executes; on-chain logs enable reproducibility - **Outputs:** auditable datasets, institution-design frameworks, peer-reviewed publications - **Governance:** human-in-the-loop oversight throughout all phases > Visual: Flow diagram—Agent Submission → Private Chain → On-Chain Logs → Research Outputs (with "Human-in-the-Loop" header)
Out of scope: building participant agents, mainnet deployment, commitments beyond pilot

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # Nyx Foundation's #1 audit ranking proves the blockchain security expertise required - **Fusaka #1:** 17 vulnerabilities reported, top ranking by report count (announced 2025-12-24) - **Operational model:** Nyx Foundation owns operations—minimal burden on partner entities - **Track record:** aligns with SGE's 2017 blockchain credential work > Visual: Achievement card—"#1" headline with "Ethereum Fusaka Audit" and "17 vulnerabilities reported"
Source: PR TIMES 2025-12-24

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # Real prizes and auditable logs differentiate this from synthetic or opaque alternatives - **Synthetic simulations:** no real stakes → limited external validity - **Corporate sandboxes:** opaque execution, non-reproducible, no third-party verification - **This proposal:** 16M JPY prizes create meaningful stakes + private chain provides auditable logs > Visual: Comparison table—Synthetic Sims | Corporate Sandboxes | This Proposal across Real Incentives, Reproducibility, Third-Party Verification
Reference: Google ADK Hackathon attracted 10,400+ participants (Google Cloud Blog 2025-09-02)

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # Modular tiers and exit gates let each entity engage at their comfort level - **4 tiers:** Observer → Advisor → Co-Designer → Sponsor (increasing involvement, not lock-in) - **Ownership:** each entity designates one owner; Nyx Foundation handles day-to-day operations - **Exit gates:** defined per phase—each transition requires explicit sign-off to continue > Visual: Tier progression—Observer (eye) | Advisor (speech) | Co-Designer (pencil) | Sponsor (star) with "Exit available at every phase"
No lock-in at any participation level

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # Each entity gets distinct strategic value: SGE research, Startale trust-infra, Sony governance - **SGE:** datasets and frameworks for learner-centered AI evaluation R&D - **Startale/Soneium:** private chain testbed demonstrates trust-infrastructure without speculative optics - **Sony Group:** frontier AI governance research positions the group at the responsible-AI frontier > Visual: Value mapping table—Entity | What This Delivers (3 rows: SGE, Startale/Soneium, Sony Group)
No speculative or financial framing

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # Private chain, sandbox controls, and human-in-the-loop governance eliminate key risks - **Private chain:** authenticated agent-only transactions, no public token, no speculation pathway - **Sandbox controls:** rate limits, kill-switches, and circuit-breakers contain agent misbehavior - **Human-in-the-loop governance:** brand/legal review gates required at each phase before progression - **Research value:** emergent harmful behaviors become valuable research data through post-hoc analysis > Visual: Layered stack—Private Chain → Sandbox → Kill-Switches → Brand/Legal Gates → Research Output
Out of scope: mainnet deployment, long-term commitments beyond pilot, building participant agents

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: BIZ UDPMincho background: White --- # 16M JPY prize pool with no upfront commitment maximizes research leverage - **Prize pool:** 16M JPY creates meaningful stakes for realistic agent behavior - **No upfront commitment:** budget allocation only after scoping confirms fit - **ROI:** reusable research assets (datasets, frameworks, publications), frontier positioning, talent pipeline > Visual: Investment summary—Entry (Time only) | Prize Pool (¥16M) | Platform (TBD in scoping) with Returns listed below
Prize breakdown: 1st 10M, 2nd 4M, 3rd 1M, special awards 1M (internal notes)
